newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo 8-mo truck deliveries down 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Volvo 8-mo truck deliveries down 17 pct.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo said on Friday its worldwide truck deliveries fell 17 percent to 41,888 trucks from January to August compared to the same 1995 period.
Volvo Truck spokesman Kjell Drotz said that for the period January to July, truck deliveries were down 16 percent.
"The downturn for the period from January to August is first and foremost due to a fall in deliveries to North and South America," Drotz told Reuters.
In North America deliveries fell 38 percent to 11,681 in January-August. In South America deliveries fell 44 percent to 3,202 trucks in that period.
"From September our new VN truck series will be on the North American market and this we expect to improve our figures for the rest of the year," Drotz said.
In Europe Volvo Truck deliveries continued to rise. In January-August they rose seven percent to 22,980 trucks.
Volvo delivered 4,025 trucks to other markets, which was a fall of 10 percent from January to August compared to the same 1995 period.
